claims.claim_text: RA 9266 IRR Section 25 requires registration/PIC before practicing architecture or using the Architect title in the Philippines.
RA 9266 IRR Section 23 authorizes suspension/revocation/cancellation after notice and hearing for listed grounds including seal misuse and aiding unauthorized practice.
RA 9266 IRR Section 29 lists prohibited conduct and penalties of PHP 100,000 to PHP 5,000,000, six months to six years imprisonment, or both.
RA 9266 IRR Sections 30 and 31 cover coerced service without a written agreement and representative liability for non-registered persons.
